name: Joel
author: Joel.
date: Date is debated, with proposals from the 800s to the 400s BC.
setting: A locust plague becomes a picture of coming judgment.
theme: Return to the Lord, and he will pour out his Spirit.

outline.label: Return to me with all your heart
The Spirit and the final judgment

christInBook: Joel promises that the Spirit will be poured out on all flesh (2:28-32). Peter says this was fulfilled at Pentecost (Acts 2:16-21). The day of the LORD finds its center in Christ.
howToRead: Joel uses a plague of locusts as a picture of a greater judgment. Read it as a call to repent, with the promise that God will restore and pour out his Spirit.
